summary: Post-refactor regression on modular Expo/React Native app (index.tsx orchestrator + src/theme.ts, src/components/*, src/components/modals/*, src/screens/*). Executed comprehensive frontend UI tests at 390x844. 26/28 checks PASS; the 2 initial FAILs were test-script issues (outlet options :not selector picked opts[0]=Semua outlet as first-non-selector; and the print/share sheet auto-closes on Cetak/Bagikan so share-qris was gone after clicking print). Retest with correct approach confirmed both flows work. All refactored screens/modals wired correctly, no red-screen, no pageerror events. Bottom nav (nav-Beranda/Riwayat/Analisa/Profil) all switch screens. Outlet selector opens OutletModal and selection updates the pill (verified pill contained 'Warkop Sejagat Meruyung'). Balance toggle hides/shows Rp 3.202.000 <-> Rp •••••••. Notif badge shows 3, clears after 'Tandai semua sudah dibaca'. Notification modal renders exactly 3 items with mark-read-* buttons. Access grid has 6 quick items with correct labels. Test payment (home + settings) inserts a transaction, updates 'Omzet hari ini'/'Transaksi hari ini' counters, and shows 'Pembayaran masuk Rp ...' toast. QRIS FAB -> QrisModal; Statis -> QrisPrintModal (Cetak fires 'Kartu QRIS dikirim ke printer' toast; Bagikan fires 'Kartu QRIS dibagikan' toast; both auto-close sheet); Dinamis -> QrisDynamicModal with amount chips + generate-qris -> mark-paid + change-amount both wired and functional. Riwayat: date-* chips (Hari ini/Minggu ini/Bulan ini) + filter-* chips (Semua/Berhasil/Menunggu) render; export-history fires 'Riwayat X transaksi diekspor ke riwayat-qris.csv' toast. Analisa renders 'Jam ramai' chart card. Profil: logout-button visible; menu-Kelola pegawai -> Employees screen (add-employee, employee-name input, employee-outlet-* options, save-employee create; edit-*/delete-* rows present). menu-Suara pembayaran -> SoundSettings: 4 voice-* cards, 4 test-voice-* buttons (tap toggles to 'Memutar' spinner, only one at a time, reverts to 'Tes'); voice selection moves checkmark; vol-Pelan/Sedang/Keras segments selectable; toggle-repeat & toggle-autosim work; pick-intro/record-intro/pick-outro/record-outro all render; preview-sound + test-payment-settings both fire. Overall: PURE STRUCTURAL REFACTOR verified — all testIDs preserved and UI/behavior identical to pre-refactor monolith. No new deprecation warnings; pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents warnings unchanged (carry-over from iteration_4, non-blocking).

issues: Pre-existing (unchanged) deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props -> boxShadow; 'props.pointerEvents' -> style.pointerEvents. Not introduced by this refactor.

test_report_links: /app/backend/tests/test_tts.py (unchanged backend regression, not re-run this iteration — backend was out of scope)
action_items: No blocking action items. Refactor is 100% behavior-preserving.
Optional cleanup (carry-over): migrate deprecated shadow* -> boxShadow and pointerEvents prop -> style.pointerEvents (Toast).

Optional: consider adding a `home-screen` / `history-screen` / `analytics-screen` / `profile-screen` root testID per screen for cleaner screen-level assertions in future test suites (current suite works via child testIDs like outlet-selector, logout-button).
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is now a clean 121-line orchestrator holding all state (tab, modals, employees, voice, intro/outro, volume, repeat, autoSim, txs) and passing setters as props — good separation.

All 6 modals live in src/components/modals/* and consume shared styles from src/theme.ts. testIDs (outlet-{o}, mark-read-{id}, filter-{f}, date-{d}, quick-{label}, voice-{id}, test-voice-{id}, vol-{k}, amount-{v}, pick-{t}, record-{t}, remove-{t}, employee-outlet-{o}, edit-{id}, delete-{id}, nav-{label}, menu-{label}) are all preserved and functional.

src/theme.ts consolidates C palette + Transaction/Employee/Tab types + outlets/transactions/outletOmzet constants + parseRp/formatRp/formatJt helpers + LOGO/CHAR_IMG/HEADER_BG assets + monolithic StyleSheet (accreted via Object.assign after StyleSheet.create). Works, but the StyleSheet.create + Object.assign pattern bypasses RN’s style ID optimization for the later blocks — optional refactor: create everything in one call.

autoSim useEffect deps intentionally excluded testPayment (eslint-disable) — fine, but confirms 15s interval keeps latest state via closure over voiceGender/intro/outro/volume/repeatTwice/selectedOutlet.
storage.setItem is fire-and-forget without await in save* helpers — acceptable for prototype but could race on rapid changes.
Home.tsx uses `t.time.startsWith('Hari ini')` to compute todayOmzet/todayTx — matches pre-refactor logic.
OutletModal, NotificationModal, EmployeeModal all use `Modal transparent animationType="fade"` correctly; QrisPrintModal + QrisDynamicModal use `animationType="slide"` with onRequestClose.
QrisPrintModal Cetak/Bagikan both call onClose() before onToast() — by design; each closes the sheet with a toast confirmation.
No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). Uses expo-image, expo-linear-gradient, expo-web-browser — all current.
No MongoDB _id leakage (backend untouched this iteration).

rca_of_issue: N/A — refactor introduced no regressions. Initial test failures were test-script issues: (1) outlet options iterated the currently-selected 'Semua outlet' first and my filter accepted it as no-op; fix: click the exact testID 'outlet-Warkop Sejagat Meruyung'. (2) print-qris click closes the sheet before share-qris is reachable; fix: open the QrisPrintModal separately for each button. Both re-runs passed.
